text: Equities are lower, but the selling is concentrated in large caps while small caps or equal-weight hold up. Volatility has jumped, but credit spreads are stable, so the fear is not yet confirmed by credit. Long-end yields are falling faster than the front end, consistent with softer long-run growth or inflation expectations. Cross-market signals broadly confirm the risk-off move.
